map.：原值 100000 元，预计使用 5 年，残值率 5%（残值 5000 元，应: : original cost 100000 CNY, 5 years of service, residual rate 5% (residual value 5000, depreciable base 95000). Straight-line annual depreciation = 95000÷5 = 19000 CNY. Double-declining-balance annual rate = 2÷5 = 40%, so year 1 = 100000×40% = 40000 CNY and year 2 = (100000−40000)×40% = 24000 CNY, with the final two years splitting the remainder less residual value. Sum-of-years'-digits denominator = 5+4+3+2+1=15, so year 1 = 95000×5/15 ≈ 31667 CNY and year 2 = 95000×4/15 ≈ 25333 CNY, declining year by year.
map.双倍余额递减法最后两年为什么要改直线法？: Why does the double-declining-balance method switch to the straight-line method in the final two years?
map.双倍余额递减法前期折旧快、后期慢，若始终按率计提，到期末无法刚好摊到残值。惯例在: The double-declining-balance method takes more depreciation early and less later, so accruing purely by the rate can never land exactly on the residual value. Convention is to average the fixed asset net value less expected net residual value over the two years before the depreciation period ends, ensuring the final book value equals the residual value.
map.三种方法对所得税有什么不同影响？: How do the three methods differ in their effect on income tax?
